title.en: Pattern transfer: the relay from Resist to Target

subtitle.zh: 每一级都必须守住CD、侧壁与停止层
subtitle.en: CD, sidewalls and the stop layer must be protected at every stage

body.zh: Hard Mask不是最终图形来源，；而是把光刻胶图形可靠传入目标层。
body.en: The Hard Mask is not the original source of the final pattern;; it reliably transfers the photoresist pattern into the target layer.

body.zh: Stack准备；平整PR/HM/；Target层
body.en: Stack preparation; Flat PR / HM /; Target layers

body.zh: Lithography；PR曝光显影形成开口，；HM与Target未被刻
body.en: Lithography; Exposure and development form an opening in PR;; HM and Target remain unetched

body.zh: 3 HM Open Etch；只把PR开口传入HM，；Target顶部刚暴露；；PR可能变薄
body.en: 3 HM Open Etch; Transfer only the PR opening into the HM;; the Target surface is just exposed;; PR may become thinner

body.zh: Resist Strip；或继续参与；双路线选择
body.en: Resist Strip; or continue participating; Choose between two routes

body.zh: A. 去除剩余PR
body.en: A. Remove the remaining PR

body.zh: B. 保留少量PR；参与早期；Target Etch
body.en: B. Keep a small amount of PR; for the early stage of; Target Etch

body.zh: Target Etch；用已图形化HM保护，；Target形成深槽/孔；；HM仍有剩余但会消耗
body.en: Target Etch; The patterned HM provides protection;; deep trenches / holes form in the Target;; HM is consumed but still remains

body.zh: 6 Strip / Retain；与检查；分两路：选择性去除HM，；或按整合需求保留HM
body.en: 6 Strip / Retain; and inspection; Two routes: selectively remove the HM,; or retain it according to integration requirements

body.zh: A.选择性去除HM；B. 保留HM（按整合需求）
body.en: A. Selectively remove HM; B. Retain HM (according to integration requirements)

body.zh: Photoresist （PR）；Hard Mask （HM）；Target；Stop Layer
body.en: Photoresist (PR); Hard Mask (HM); Target; Stop Layer

body.zh: 逐级CD账本（CD Bias逐级累计）
body.en: Stage-by-stage CD ledger (CD Bias accumulates at successive stages)

body.zh: Litho CD；HM Open CD；Target TopCD；Target Bottom CD
body.en: Litho CD; HM Open CD; Target Top CD; Target Bottom CD

body.zh: • HM Open Selectivity；• CD Bias；• Sidewall Profile；• Target / Stop Layer Damage
body.en: • HM Open Selectivity; • CD Bias; • Sidewall Profile; • Target / Stop Layer Damage

body.zh: •更强各向异性：有利于垂直转移，；但可能加剧Mask Faceting或下层损伤
body.en: • Greater anisotropy benefits vertical transfer,; but may increase Mask Faceting or underlying-layer damage

body.zh: • 更多Passivation：改善側壁保护，；但可能增加Residue / Footing
body.en: • More Passivation improves sidewall protection,; but may increase Residue / Footing

body.zh: • Over-Etch Margin：保证开口，；却增加Mask消耗
body.en: • Over-Etch Margin ensures opening completion,; but increases Mask consumption

body.zh: Incomplete HM Open；CD Shrink / Enlargement；HM Faceting；Bottom Residue；Target提前暴露 / Mask Breakthrough
body.en: Incomplete HM Open; CD Shrink / Enlargement; HM Faceting; Bottom Residue; Premature Target exposure / Mask Breakthrough

body.zh: Post-Litho CD；Post-HM Open CD；Cross-section Profile；Target Depth /；Bottom CD；Mask Remaining；Residue / Defect；回馈 HM Open与Target Etch
body.en: Post-Litho CD; Post-HM Open CD; Cross-section Profile; Target Depth /; Bottom CD; Mask Remaining; Residue / Defect; Feedback to HM Open and Target Etch

body.zh: 是否先去除光刻胶，以及Hard Mask最终Strip或Retain，取决于材料和整合路线。
body.en: Whether PR is removed first, and whether the Hard Mask is ultimately stripped or retained, depend on material and integration route.
